definitions.explanation: Marks the deadline by which a one-time action is completed. After a plain verb it means "before ~ happens": {着|つ}くまでに (before arriving).

examples.japanese: ⟦{五時|ごじ}→五時：30899_goji⟧までに⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧までに⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I'll hand in the report by tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧までに、⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧おこう。
examples.english: Let's think about what to say before we get to the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧までにあと⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧やせたい。
examples.english: I want to lose three more kilos before the wedding.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
The test is the verb that follows.
- ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ + a continuing action: ⟦{五時|ごじ}→五時：30899_goji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (wait until five; the waiting goes on up to five)
- までに + a one-time action: ⟦{五時|ごじ}→五時：30899_goji⟧までに⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ (be back by five; the return happens at some point before five)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧までに: by when — ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧までに⟦{払|はら}えば→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧
- {今|いま}までに: so far, up to now — {今|いま}までに⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧
- までに⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: by (at the latest), with the deadline emphasized — ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧までに⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{終|お}わるだろう
- ~までに~⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧: must ~ by ~
